source: The Graph — Uniswap v3 mainnet subgraph (5zvR82QoaXYFyDEKLZ9t6v9adgnptxYpKpSbxtgVENFV)
method: realized = fee income - impermanent loss over a 30-day poolDayData window; advertised = most recent day fees, annualized on current TVL (the standard DEX-UI formula)

canary.note: stable/stable pairs must show ~0 impermanent loss
corr(advertised APR, fee return) must be clearly positive — both are fee-derived. A weak value means the estimator is broken, not that the market is odd.

correlation.note: advertised vs realized APR. Reported at 3 liveness gates x {raw, 2% trimmed} x {pearson, spearman} because the value moves a lot across those choices — see README honesty box.

byRange.note: Uniswap v3 LPs concentrate. The v2/full-range formula is the MOST GENEROUS case for the pool. Reported at 4 ranges; the defect must survive all of them or it is a parameter.
